answer: Written in a formal academic rhythm, balance of technical clauses and empirical references register, it stays short. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Reaching the spiral of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the lotus of a task receipt, and the relic is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
